title: Solar technician and electric-vehicle (EV) mechanic training
summary: Short skill courses (a few weeks to a few months) for installing and repairing solar panels and for servicing electric two- and three-wheelers. Demand is growing as solar and EVs spread.
qualification: Usually 10th pass or ITI. Check each course.
opportunities: Jobs with solar installers and EV service centres
Own repair or installation shop
Better pay as an ITI electrician with extra skills
next_steps: Choose a course from a recognised or government-backed provider, not from an unknown advertisement.
Check the duration, certificate type and total fees before you pay.
Practise the skill every day and build a small portfolio of work you can show.

title: Drone pilot and drone technician
summary: Training to fly small drones legally and to maintain them. Drones are used in farming (spraying), surveying, photography and delivery. Training is given by approved remote pilot training organisations.
qualification: Usually 10th pass and age 18 or more. Check the current DGCA rules and the training centre.

entrance_exams.name: DGCA approved remote pilot training organisations

opportunities: Drone pilot for farming, survey and media companies
Own drone service business
Drone repair technician
next_steps: Choose a course from a recognised or government-backed provider, not from an unknown advertisement.
Check the duration, certificate type and total fees before you pay.
Practise the skill every day and build a small portfolio of work you can show.

title: Start a farm-based business (dairy, poultry, mushroom, beekeeping, nursery)
summary: Small businesses built on farming skills and local demand. You can learn the work at a Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) and use bank loans and government support schemes to start.
qualification: Open to anyone. Training courses at KVKs and agriculture universities are open to farmers and rural youth.
opportunities: Regular income from your own unit
Loans and subsidies through banks and government schemes
Supply to local markets, dairies and food companies
next_steps: Pick one activity and learn it first: join a short training at your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
Make a simple plan: cost, space, market and daily work. Visit someone already running the same business.
Look at loans and subsidy schemes for farmers on this site and ask your bank about them, and register your business on the Udyam portal.

title: Government computer courses (NIELIT CCC, O Level, ADCA)
summary: NIELIT is a government institute that offers computer courses recognised for many jobs. CCC is a basic computer course often asked for in government jobs.
qualification: Open to all for CCC. Other levels may need 10th or 12th. Check each course.
opportunities: Computer skill certificate for government and private office jobs
Data entry and office assistant roles
Base for BCA or IT diplomas
next_steps: Choose a course from a recognised or government-backed provider, not from an unknown advertisement.
Check the duration, certificate type and total fees before you pay.
Practise the skill every day and build a small portfolio of work you can show.

title: Beauty, wellness and fitness careers
summary: Short courses for hair and beauty work, spa and wellness, and fitness training. Many people start with a job and later open their own salon or studio.
opportunities: Salon, spa and gym jobs
Own salon or studio
Home-based services
next_steps: Choose a course from a recognised or government-backed provider, not from an unknown advertisement.
Check the duration, certificate type and total fees before you pay.
Practise the skill every day and build a small portfolio of work you can show.

title: Driving, logistics and warehouse jobs
summary: Jobs in transport, delivery and warehouses. A valid driving licence and short training from approved driving or logistics training centres help you get hired.
qualification: Usually 10th pass or less for helper roles; a licence needs the minimum age set by the transport rules.
opportunities: Steady jobs with transport and e-commerce companies
Own vehicle or small transport business
Growth to supervisor roles
next_steps: Choose a course from a recognised or government-backed provider, not from an unknown advertisement.
Check the duration, certificate type and total fees before you pay.
Practise the skill every day and build a small portfolio of work you can show.

title: Anganwadi, ASHA and community health worker jobs
summary: Local government posts for women who work with mothers, children and families in villages and towns. Vacancies are announced by the district or state office, usually for your own area.
qualification: Usually 10th or 12th pass and local residence. The notice lists the exact rules.
courses: Auxiliary nurse midwife (after the diploma course)

entrance_exams.name: District and state notices (Women and Child Development / Health)

opportunities: Stable local government work
Honorarium and benefits as per current rules
Path to nursing and health roles
next_steps: Read the latest official notification: eligibility, age limit, selection steps and dates.
Start preparing early with the official syllabus and previous question papers.
Keep documents ready (marksheets, category and domicile certificates) and apply only on the official website.

official_links.label: Ministry of Women and Child Development

title: Village and revenue jobs (Talathi, Patwari, Gram Sevak)
summary: State government posts that handle land records, village development and local administration. Each state holds its own recruitment, so the name and rules differ.
qualification: Usually 12th pass or graduation, depending on the state and post. Read the state notice.
courses: Clerk and assistant posts in district offices

entrance_exams.name: Your state public service commission or recruitment board

opportunities: Permanent state government job near your home
Promotion through departmental exams
next_steps: Read the latest official notification: eligibility, age limit, selection steps and dates.
Start preparing early with the official syllabus and previous question papers.
Keep documents ready (marksheets, category and domicile certificates) and apply only on the official website.

title: Traditional artisan skills and support (PM Vishwakarma)
summary: A central scheme for people who work with their hands in traditional trades, such as carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, tailors, cobblers and barbers. It offers recognition, skill training, tools support and low-interest loans, as per the current rules.
qualification: People doing a listed traditional trade with their hands. The official site lists the trades and the age and other conditions.
courses: Skill training for the listed trades
Loans without collateral at low interest, as per the scheme
opportunities: Better income from your own trade
Training and a certificate
Easier access to credit for your workshop
next_steps: Open the official PM Vishwakarma portal and read the list of trades and the conditions.
Register with your Aadhaar and mobile number, usually through a Common Service Centre, and keep your trade details ready.
Follow the portal messages for verification, training and loan steps.
